<location path="sdk/python/src/openlit/instrumentation/together/utils.py" line_range="83-84" />
<code_context>
             for tool in delta_tools:
-                index = tool.get("index", 0)
+                # The Together SDK types `index` as a float.
+                index = int(tool.get("index") or 0)
                 scope._tools.extend([{}] * (index + 1 - len(scope._tools)))
                 function = tool.get("function") or {}
                 if tool.get("id"):
</code_context>
<issue_to_address>
**Malformed tool index exhausts memory**

When a Together-compatible endpoint returns a tool-call chunk with a very large finite index, `process_chunk` converts the provider-supplied index to an integer and uses it to allocate `index + 1` entries in `scope._tools` without a bound. A single chunk with a very large finite index exhausts process memory and takes down the application.

Reject tool-call indexes outside a reasonable bounded range before extending `scope._tools`.
</issue_to_address>
~~~

</details>

## Reviewer's Guide Fixes Together streamed tool-call crashes by converting SDK float indexes to integers, and corrects finish-reason extraction to prefer the choice payload while preserving top-level compatibility. New synchronous and asynchronous tests validate stream delivery and span metadata for tool-call and text streams. #### Sequence diagram for safe Together streamed tool-call processing ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Together as TogetherSDK participant Wrapper as StreamWrapper participant Process as process_chunk participant Scope as SpanScope actor Caller Together->>Wrapper: streamed ChatCompletionChunk Wrapper->>Process: process_chunk(scope, chunk) Process->>Process: response_as_dict(chunk) Process->>Process: int(tool.index) Process->>Scope: update _tools Process->>Scope: update _finish_reason from choices[0].finish_reason Process-->>Wrapper: processed chunk Wrapper-->>Caller: yield chunk ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Normalize Together tool-call indexes before using them to allocate and update aggregated tool state. |
  • Convert SDK-provided float indexes to integers, defaulting missing or falsy values to zero.
  • Preserve streamed tool-call metadata without allowing the stream wrapper to propagate a sizing/indexing TypeError.
| `sdk/python/src/openlit/instrumentation/together/utils.py` | | Record streamed finish reasons from the Together choice payload while retaining compatible top-level handling. |
  • Update the finish reason from choices[0].finish_reason when non-null.
  • Only update from a top-level finish_reason when one is present, avoiding the prior string value "None".
  • Allow existing error/incomplete finish-reason fallbacks to operate after usage chunks.
| `sdk/python/src/openlit/instrumentation/together/utils.py` | | Add sync and async regression coverage using Together SDK ChatCompletionChunk objects. |
  • Verify tool-call streams reach callers and record tool name, call ID, arguments, and finish reason.
  • Verify text streams record the choice-level length finish reason.
  • Exercise the Together SDK float-typed tool-call index and usage chunks.
| `sdk/python/tests/test_together_stream_chunks.py` | ---
